Hi Tessa / Ben —

Thanks again for the time last week. Per our conversation, I’m sending the draft renewal quote for Greenleaf Systems for the Firstline seller footprint. Highlights: 250 seats (field sellers + SDR overlap), onboarding hours reduced from 40 -> 24 thanks to the new kickstart bundle, and an optional add-on for advanced sequence analytics.

I attached the PDF quote (Outreach_Renewal_Quote_Q4.pdf) and a CSV with line items. If you want a different seat tier or a temporary 90-day seat swap to cover ramp, we can model it.

Questions I know you raised:
- SOC2 evidence: attaching a link to our report and audit summary (see link below).
- Exec credits: I can propose a one-time credit but need sign-off from my manager; if you can loop in finance or the buyer it helps speed approval.
- DocuSign: once the commercial terms are agreed I’ll generate the envelope.

Quick ask: can you confirm the proposed seat count and whether Greenleaf requires SSO/JIT provisioning in the next 30 days? We have a renewal cutoff of 2027-12-01 for current pricing.

Attachments: Outreach_Renewal_Quote_Q4.pdf, quote_line_items.csv
Links: https://outreach.io/security/soc2-2027

Sarah — thanks for the quote and fast turn. A few clarifications from our side: 

1) Seat mix: the 250 number looks right as a starting point, but we need a 30-day window to adjust by +/- 25 seats without penalty; please include a delta pricing line.
2) Security evidence: please attach the SOC2 PDF to your next email (we prefer attachments for procurement). HubSpot (if applicable) will be part of the integrated stack and needs the same evidence.
3) Credits: we may be able to approve a modest one-time credit, but I need a written justification from Outreach showing where the credit is applied on the quote (line item level) and the total net ARR impact.

Procurement contact at Greenleaf is procurement@greenleaf.com — please copy them on the commercial package so they can run it through their PO/terms review.

Ben / Marissa / Lauren — can the GTM finance team quick-check the attached pricing and confirm whether a 60-day payment term is acceptable? If Outreach needs an expedited approval path, we can escalate to legal/finance.

If Outreach can attach SOC2 and the revised quote with delta pricing and explicit credit line, I’ll get this to procurement for their review.

Thanks,
Tessa
Director, GTM Ops — Redwood Inference
